newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHIPPER STRINTZIS SAYS 96 TURNOVER UP 15.9 PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHIPPER STRINTZIS SAYS 96 TURNOVER UP 15.9 PCT.

text.p: Greek passenger shipper Strintzis Lines said in a statement that its 1996 turnover rose 15.9 percent to 21.14 billion drachmas from 18.24 billion in 1995.
The number of transported trucks rose to 25,183 from 19,373 while the total amount of fares rose 14.4 percent during the same period, the statement said.

Strintzis recently acquired a ferry boat, Ionian Bridge, which has a transportation capacity of 685 vehicles, 85 of which are trucks. It can carry 800 passengers and contains 200 beds. Its speed is 19 knots.
The ship will be renovated at Perama Shipyards and will be added to Strintzis' fleet of fours ships which are currently covering the route from Greece to Italy.
Shares of Strintzis closed down two drachmas at 988 on Tuesday. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
